title: [Mouse Without Borders] Stop ignoring IP address mapping rules

proposed_comments.title: Policy-only mappings are mislabeled
proposed_comments.body:
### Policy-only mappings are mislabeled

**Severity:** `low`

When a matching address comes from the policy-defined list, this branch still reports that a “user-defined” mapping is in use. Because policy addresses now reach this notification even when user-defined rules are disabled, the notice can misidentify a policy-only mapping. Use neutral wording for configured mappings in both the log and tooltip.

```suggestion
Logger.LogDebug("Using configured Name-to-IP mappings with DNS lookup for " + machineName);

Common.ShowToolTip("Using configured Name-to-IP mappings with DNS lookup for " + machineName, 3000, ToolTipIcon.Info, false);
```

confidence.rationale: The changed path directly adds policy-defined addresses before the non-empty guard, while both reached notification strings still say user-defined; the settings getter confirms the policy that disables user rules yields an empty user list.
